title: TikTok Keyword Discovery — Videos, Photos, Hashtags & Creators Input
description: Search TikTok by keyword for videos or photo posts, or look up hashtag metadata and top posts. Optional discovery expansion finds more posts from related searches, hashtags and sounds.

searchType.title: What to Search
searchType.description: Videos: keyword video search. Photos: slideshow/photo search. Hashtags: hashtag metadata plus its top videos (uses the Hashtags field).

queries.title: Search Queries
queries.description: Keywords or phrases to search for (searchType=videos or photos). Each query is searched independently.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Hashtags to look up (searchType=hashtags). The # is optional, e.g. coffee or #coffee.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max Results Per Query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum posts to collect per query or hashtag, before filters. TikTok itself usually returns about 150-220 posts per query even when you ask for more. For hashtags, the metadata row is not counted against this limit.

sortBy.title: Sort By
sortBy.description: Client-side sort applied after collecting results. TikTok's web search does not support server-side sorting, so this only reorders the posts TikTok returned.

publishedWithin.title: Published Within
publishedWithin.description: Client-side filter that drops posts older than the selected window, based on each post's creation time. TikTok ranks results by relevance, not date, so a narrow window can return fewer posts than requested; the actor scans up to 5x the requested count (capped at 500) to fill it.

minDurationSeconds.title: Minimum Duration (seconds)
minDurationSeconds.description: Drop videos shorter than this. Leave blank for no minimum.

maxDurationSeconds.title: Maximum Duration (seconds)
maxDurationSeconds.description: Drop videos longer than this. Leave blank for no maximum.

excludeAds.title: Exclude Ads
excludeAds.description: Drop posts TikTok flags as paid advertisements.

minLikeCount.title: Minimum Like Count
minLikeCount.description: Drop posts with fewer likes than this. Leave blank for no minimum.

minViewCount.title: Minimum View Count
minViewCount.description: Drop posts with fewer plays/views than this. Leave blank for no minimum.

uniqueAuthors.title: One Post Per Author
uniqueAuthors.description: Keep at most one post per creator, so the results read like a creator shortlist. When a sort is selected, the top-ranked post from each creator is kept.

maxPostsPerAuthor.title: Max Posts Per Author
maxPostsPerAuthor.description: Optional cap on how many posts one creator may contribute. Ignored when One Post Per Author is on.

enableExpansion.title: Enable Discovery Expansion
enableExpansion.description: After each keyword search, run extra searches derived from its own results: related searches, its top hashtags and its most-reused sound. Increases run time and the number of posts found. Videos only.

expansionSources.title: Expansion Sources
expansionSources.description: Which discovery sources to use when expansion is on. All three can be combined.

maxExpansionQueriesPerSeed.title: Max Expansion Searches Per Query
maxExpansionQueriesPerSeed.description: Maximum number of extra searches to run per keyword when expansion is on. Each one costs roughly as much run time as the original search.

includeHashtagMetadata.title: Include Hashtag Metadata
includeHashtagMetadata.description: For hashtag searches: emit a metadata row with the hashtag's post count, view count, description and images. Also attaches metadata to hashtag-expansion posts when expansion is on.
